text: Definition agreed in discussion with Juan Vaz and Fahim Ebrahimi, 2026-11-18.
There is no ICD-7 or ICD-8 code for liver transplantation.
The classification system of the procedure codes 5200, JJC, DJ005 and DJ006 is not stated in the source document; confirm it (for example Swedish operation/KVÅ codes) before use.

ICD-9 V42H and ICD-10 Z94.4 describe transplant status and T86.4 describes transplant failure and rejection, so these can be recorded after the transplantation date. The procedure codes are the more reliable marker of the date.
